newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pearl Oriental buys HK$375 mln property.
newsitem.headline: Pearl Oriental buys HK$375 mln property.

text.p: Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd has agreed to buy a residential property in Hong Kong's Peak district from third party Wealthy Way Enterprises Ltd for HK$375 million, it said in a statement on Thursday.
The property is a site of 43,824 sq ft at Pollock's Path, the Peak, it said.
The deal is expected to be completed on February 19, 1997.

"Respective proposals on letting out the property and redevelopment of the site into several detached houses for rental or resale purposes are being considered," the company's chairman Wong Kwan said in the statement.
